g.title: Silicon calculation input: 7 conventional cells
g.desc: Exact input fractional positions projected orthographically; a=5.43356003 angstrom, [100] transport. Transverse directions are periodic. Dashed layer boundaries mark the conventional-cell repeat. Atom positions are not jittered. Lengths span cell boundaries.

g.text: The crossover length has not been assigned from these short benchmarks.
